10_trade_through_fills

Shadow bid 10 @ 5000.00 behind 100 lots; o4 (50) rests at 4999.75. A sweep trades 100 at 5000.00 (o1, o2) and 20 at 4999.75 (o4) in one event. Exactly the queue ahead traded at the price, but the sweep went through the price: the exact engine fills 10 by trade-through. A queue-only simulator does not fill.
